Title: Aarav's Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Anil - 44 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Naira - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Anita, Anil and Naira stand near him.]

Naira: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav goes jogging in the park.]

Aarav: "I'm ready!"

[Aarav plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Aarav (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Aarav does yoga on a mat.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Anita and Naira stand near him.]

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Aarav waves goodbye to Mother.]

Aarav (excited): "Mom, look at this."

[Aarav smiles at Mother.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
